sell.howTitle: How to sell your used furniture in Dubai
how: Send photos and a short description with this form.
We reply on WhatsApp with an offer, usually within 24 hours.
We collect the item from your home and pay you on pickup.

faqs.q: How fast will I get an offer?
faqs.a: LoopHome usually sends a cash offer on WhatsApp within 24 hours of receiving your photos.

faqs.q: Is pickup free?
faqs.a: Yes. If we agree a price, we collect the item from your home at no cost.

faqs.q: Do you collect from my area of Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. LoopHome buys and collects all over Dubai, from JVC, JLT and Dubai Marina to Business Bay, Downtown, Al Barsha and Al Furjan, and across the rest of the UAE, including Abu Dhabi, Sharjah and Ajman. Pickup is free.

faqs.q: I'm leaving Dubai soon. Can you buy everything at once?
faqs.a: Yes. Send photos or a short video of everything on WhatsApp with your move-out date, and we reply with one offer for all items, usually within 24 hours. If you book ahead, we can collect on your handover day.

faqs.q: Do I need a permit from my building for the pickup?
faqs.a: Many Dubai towers ask for a move-out permit or a service-lift booking when large furniture leaves. Check with your building management and tell us the times they allow; we plan the pickup around them.

faqs.q: How do I get paid?
faqs.a: In cash when we collect the item, at the price we agreed on WhatsApp.

faqs.q: What if I don't like the offer?
faqs.a: You don't have to accept it. A sell request doesn't oblige either side.

faqs.q: Can I list my item instead of selling it to you?
faqs.a: Yes. Choose "List it on LoopHome" and set your own price. After approval we handle the buyer and delivery, and you get your price minus the commission shown on the form.

faqs.q: Do you buy office furniture?
faqs.a: Yes: office chairs, desks and printers, from homes and businesses. Send photos through this form, or message us on WhatsApp if you have many pieces.

moving.description: Movers and packers in Dubai for apartments, villas and offices, and moves across the UAE. Free site visit first, then one clear quote on WhatsApp.
moving.h1: Movers and packers in Dubai for homes, villas and offices
moving.intro: Moving between Dubai communities, into a new tower apartment, out of a villa at the end of a lease, or setting up a new office? Every move starts with a free site visit, also called a moving survey. We look at what needs moving and the lift and parking access at both addresses, then give you a clear quote, with no guesswork and no surprises on moving day.
moving.stepsTitle: How our Dubai moving service works
steps: Request a site visit with this form.
We visit, inspect everything and plan the move around your building's permit and service-lift times.
You get a clear quote on WhatsApp.
We pack, move and set up on the agreed day.

faqs.q: Is the moving survey (site visit) free?
faqs.a: Yes. LoopHome's site visit, also called a moving survey, is free and has no obligation: we see what needs moving and the access at both addresses, then send one quote on WhatsApp.

faqs.q: How much do movers cost in Dubai?
faqs.a: It depends on how much there is to move (apartment, villa or office), the floors and access at both addresses, the distance, and any packing or dismantling. We send one quote on WhatsApp after the free site visit, with no obligation.

faqs.q: Which areas of Dubai do you move?
faqs.a: All of Dubai, including JVC, JVT, JLT, JBR, Dubai Marina, Al Barsha, Jumeirah, Business Bay, Downtown, DIFC, Al Furjan, Arjan, Dubailand, Dubai Investment Park (DIP), Dubai Sports City and Motor City. We also move within and between all emirates.

faqs.q: Do I need a move permit from my building?
faqs.a: Most Dubai towers and communities ask for a move-in or move-out permit and a service-lift booking. You get these from your building management, and we plan moving day around the times they allow.

faqs.q: Do you move offices in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes: workstations, meeting rooms, IT equipment and furniture, with dismantling and assembly, in business districts such as DIFC, Business Bay, JLT and Dubai Internet City, and across the UAE. Office buildings usually set move times and need approval, so we plan around them.

faqs.q: Do you move from Dubai to Abu Dhabi, Al Ain or Sharjah?
faqs.a: Yes. We move homes and offices within and between all emirates, including from Dubai to Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, Sharjah and Ajman.

faqs.q: Do you pack and dismantle furniture?
faqs.a: Yes. Choose packing and dismantling and assembly in the form, and we include them in your quote after the site visit. With packing, we bring the boxes, wrap and labels.

faqs.q: Do you move furniture abroad?
faqs.a: No. We move within the UAE only. If you're leaving the UAE, we can buy the furniture and appliances you're not shipping, with one offer and a free pickup.

faqs.q: Can you buy the furniture I don't want to move?
faqs.a: Yes. LoopHome also buys used furniture and appliances for cash. Send photos through the Sell form and we usually reply with one offer on WhatsApp within 24 hours, with a free pickup timed around your move.

faqs.q: How far ahead should I book movers in Dubai?
faqs.a: As soon as you know your date. Moves bunch up around month-end, when many leases start and end, and your building may need a few days to approve the move permit. Moving at short notice? Pick the earliest site-visit date and say so in the details, and we'll tell you on WhatsApp what we can do.

guide.heading: Apartment, villa and office moves in Dubai and across the UAE
guide.body: We move apartments, villas and offices within Dubai and between all emirates, from a single room to a full office. Our team handles loading, transport and unloading, and can pack, dismantle and reassemble your furniture when you add those services.

guide.heading: Tower moves in Dubai Marina, JLT, JBR, Business Bay and Downtown
guide.body: Most towers ask for a move-in or move-out permit from building management and a booked service-lift slot, and some only allow moves at set hours. Book both before you fix the date, and tell us the floor and lift size at the site visit so we plan the crew and packing around them.

guide.heading: Villa moves in JVT, Al Furjan, Jumeirah, Motor City and Dubailand
guide.body: Villa and townhouse moves usually mean more rooms, garden furniture, and large wardrobes or beds that need dismantling. Parking is often easier than at a tower, but many communities still ask for approval before a move, so check with your community management first. At the site visit we check doorways, stairs and what needs dismantling.

guide.heading: What affects your moving quote
guide.body: The price depends on how much there is to move, the floor and access at both addresses, the distance between them, and the extra services you choose. That's why every move starts with a free site visit: you get one clear quote before you book, with no obligation.

technician.description: Book a handyman, plumber, electrician or AC service in Dubai and the UAE, plus curtain fitting, furniture assembly and TV mounting. We confirm on WhatsApp.
technician.h1: Handyman, plumber, electrician and AC repair in Dubai
technician.intro: Plumbing, electrical, AC servicing, curtains and blinds, TV mounting, furniture assembly and small repairs for homes and offices all over Dubai and the rest of the UAE. Just moved in, or getting ready to hand your flat back? Tell us what needs doing and when, and we'll book a technician visit.
technician.noFee: The price is confirmed with you by phone before the visit.
technician.servicesTitle: Plumbing, electrical and AC services in Dubai
steps: Tell us the job and your preferred time.
We call or WhatsApp you to confirm the visit and price.
A technician visits and does the work.

faqs.q: How quickly can a technician come?
faqs.a: Choose your preferred day and time, or mark the job as urgent and we'll do our best to come sooner.

faqs.q: How much does a visit cost?
faqs.a: We confirm the price with you by phone before the visit, so there are no surprises.

faqs.q: Which areas of Dubai do your technicians cover?
faqs.a: LoopHome technicians visit homes and offices all over Dubai, including JVC, JVT, JLT, JBR, Dubai Marina, Al Barsha, Business Bay, Downtown, Al Furjan and Motor City, and the rest of the UAE.

faqs.q: Can I send photos of the problem?
faqs.a: Yes. Photos help the technician bring the right parts and tools.

faqs.q: Do you have a handyman for small jobs?
faqs.a: Yes. Choose Handyman (general repairs), describe the job and add photos if you can.

faqs.q: Do you service and repair ACs in Dubai apartments and villas?
faqs.a: Yes: cleaning, gas top-ups and repairs. Choose AC maintenance, tell us what's wrong (not cooling, leaking or noisy) and how many units, and add photos if you can. Many Dubai residents book a service before the summer heat.

faqs.q: Do your technicians bring parts and materials?
faqs.a: Our technicians bring the tools and common parts for the job you describe; bigger parts are quoted and agreed with you first.

faqs.q: I've just moved in. Can you put up curtains, mount the TV and assemble furniture?
faqs.a: Yes. Choose the service you need in the form, such as Curtains & blinds or Furniture assembly (which includes TV mounting), and describe the job. If you need more than one service, say so in the description and we'll confirm on WhatsApp what we can arrange.

faqs.q: Can you fix things before I hand my apartment back?
faqs.a: Yes, for small jobs. Choose Handyman (general repairs), list what needs doing, such as a dripping tap, a loose fitting or taking down curtain rails, and add photos. Book it a few days before your handover inspection.

faqs.q: How often should I service my AC in Dubai?
faqs.a: Most homes have the AC serviced before summer each year, and more often if it runs all day or the home is dusty.

Our technicians visit apartments in areas such as JLT, Dubai Marina and Business Bay, and villas in JVT, Al Furjan and Motor City.

guide.body: Moving into an unfurnished rental usually means curtain rails, blinds, a TV bracket and flat-pack furniture before anything else. Choose curtains and blinds or furniture assembly above and describe the job.

guide.heading: How a technician visit works
